findings.title: Validator R-01 per-family branch is unreachable, so the check can never fail for a connected hardware family
findings.evidence: scripts/check-marea-unit-economics.mjs:2039-2069; the branch at line 2067 reads `if (!hasRecurringLine && !declaredUnknown && !cloudPerDevice.length)`. `cloudPerDevice` is non-empty in the shipped dataset (RC-006/007/008/009/010/011/012/014/015/016 and Cloudflare Workers inputs), so `!cloudPerDevice.length` is false and the per-family requirement can never trigger. The only negative test (scripts/check-marea-unit-economics.test.mjs:570-580) removes all cloud inputs, which also empties `cloudPerDevice`, so it passes without exercising the per-family branch.
findings.description: Contract R-01 requires every connected hardware SKU (HUB, WATCH, DISPLAY, AIS) to carry recurring cost inputs or an explicit UNKNOWN. The validator's family-level enforcement is dead code whenever the global cloud-input list is non-empty, which is always true for a valid dataset. The 49/49 PASS result therefore does not prove R-01.
findings.requiredCorrection: Remove the trailing `&& !cloudPerDevice.length` from the per-family condition and add a negative test that strips recurring cost lines and declared UNKNOWN entries from exactly one connected family while leaving global cloud inputs intact, asserting R-01 fails.

findings.title: HUB, DISPLAY and AIS records carry no recurring cost input or explicit UNKNOWN recurring entry
findings.evidence: docs/marea/economics/data/unit-economics.json: all UE-HUB-* records have empty unknownVariableCostCategories except HUB-PRO's HUB_PRO_INCREMENTAL_LINES; UE-DISPLAY-* have no recurring category or UNKNOWN; UE-AIS-* only declare AIS_CONNECTED_COST. None has a CLOUD/CELLULAR/CONNECTIVITY/TELEMETRY/NOTIFICATION line. Requirement: docs/marea/economics/data/MC12-DATA-CONTRACT.md:327 (R-01).
findings.description: Contract R-01 lists HUB, WATCH, DISPLAY and AIS as connected hardware that must declare recurring cost exposure or an explicit UNKNOWN. WATCH does (cellular/cloud/notification) and WATCH-FLEET subscription records do; HUB, DISPLAY and AIS do not declare it at all. The exposed data gap is currently masked by F01.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add explicit recurring UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE declarations (for example a customer-supplied connectivity/data-path entry) to the HUB, DISPLAY and AIS records, or amend the contract's connected-family list through change control with a recorded decision. Then re-run R-01 after F01 is fixed.

findings.title: PR_CREATED status block is self-contradictory and the gate freezes the false value
findings.evidence: docs/marea/economics/data/manifest.json:52 (`"PR_CREATED": false`) versus docs/marea/economics/MC-12-DELIVERY.md:163 and docs/marea/economics/MC12-EXECUTIVE-REPORT.md:247 (`PR_CREATED = true`); PR #19 is OPEN/draft/MERGEABLE (gh pr view 19). The validator's FROZEN_STATUS_BLOCK (scripts/check-marea-unit-economics.mjs:95-108, line 104) also hardcodes false and D-03 (lines 2331-2350) enforces it, so the gate certifies the inconsistency.
findings.description: The machine-readable status block states that no PR was created, although the registry row names PR #19 and D18/D19 state PR_CREATED = true. This violates the required status-block consistency across manifest/D18/D19/registry and is a truthfulness defect in the evidence chain.
findings.requiredCorrection: Set manifest.statusBlock.PR_CREATED to true and update FROZEN_STATUS_BLOCK (with a negative test that would fail if it were false), keeping MERGED/DEPLOYED/MC13_STARTED false; or, if the intended semantic is 'merged PR', rename the field and align D18/D19/registry wording. Re-run the gate after correction.

The governance conclusion LICENSING_RIGHTS_GRANTED=false still holds.

findings.title: Evidence-class accounting omits the single ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION provider record
findings.evidence: docs/marea/economics/data/manifest.json:37 engineeringAssumptions = 0, but providers.json contains PE-CC-013 with evidenceClass ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION (offshore coverage assumption). findings.title: Registry row 12 contains a placeholder commit reference and a premature review reference
findings.evidence: docs/marea/execution/MASTER-PROMPT-REGISTRY.md:58: 'implementation commit `e6e181a`, correction commit `correction commit in the final head`'; the same row names docs/marea/economics/review/MC-12-REVIEW.md as an existing artefact although the review is authored after the delivery commit.

findings.title: Bundle economic component lists deviate from bundle-definitions.json
findings.evidence: docs/marea/economics/data/bundle-economics.json: BE-SAIL (lines 166-207) componentEconomicIds include UE-SENSE-MODULE-100-BASE but not UE-PILOT-COASTAL-100-BASE; BE-COMPLETE (lines 211-260) omits PILOT-COASTAL; BE-FLEET (lines 268-283) has an empty component list. docs/marea/bundles/bundle-definitions.json SAIL components: SL-01 NAV-PRO INCLUDED, SL-02 HUB-STANDARD INCLUDED, SL-03 PILOT-COASTAL QUOTATION_REQUIRED requiredForOutcome, SL-04 SENSE-WIND CONDITIONAL (not included); COMPLETE CP-09 PILOT-COASTAL QUOTATION_REQUIRED; FLEET FP-01 FLEET-START INCLUDED. MC12-BUNDLE-ECONOMICS.md:13-16 claims 'No included product is added or removed'.
findings.description: SAIL counts a CONDITIONAL SENSE-WIND module as a bundle component and omits the required PILOT-COASTAL component; COMPLETE omits PILOT (acknowledged only as an unknown category); FLEET lists no component although FLEET-START is INCLUDED. No numeric result changes because SAIL/COMPLETE known variable cost and contribution are null and FLEET has no package price, but component identity is not traceable to the authoritative definition as claimed.
findings.requiredCorrection: Align componentEconomicIds/componentCosts with INCLUDED and QUOTATION_REQUIRED components of bundle-definitions.json (or label conditional components explicitly and document deliberate omissions in the machine record, not only in prose); reconcile the BE-FLEET component list with FP-01.

findings.title: Validator A-06 does not verify bundle composition against INCLUDED lines or quantities
findings.evidence: scripts/check-marea-unit-economics.mjs:1595-1610: A-06 builds definitionFamilies from `components` plus `optionalComponents` and only checks that each component family is present somewhere in that union. It does not check inclusion type, requiredForOutcome, or quantity/kit expansion.
findings.description: An invented optional or CONDITIONAL inclusion, or a missing required component, would pass A-06; the check is a family-membership check rather than the composition check that contract §4.8 describes. This is how F08 escaped the gate.
findings.requiredCorrection: Check componentEconomicIds families against the INCLUDED set (and QUOTATION_REQUIRED where requiredForOutcome is true), verify kit-expansion quantities from senseKitExpansion, and add negative tests injecting a conditional-only component and a missing required component.

findings.title: Bundle unknownVariableCostCategories include fixed certification costs
findings.evidence: docs/marea/economics/data/bundle-economics.json: BE-START and BE-PROTECT list CERTIFICATION inside unknownVariableCostCategories with materiality MATERIAL; contract MC12-DATA-CONTRACT.md:301 (V-17) distinguishes fixed one-off unknowns from unit-variable unknowns.
findings.description: Fixed certification costs are recorded in the variable-unknown vocabulary; the validator's V-17 suppresses contributionPct for any material entry there. In these bundles the suppression is independently justified by a genuine variable unknown (chart licence, cellular connectivity), so no numeric effect exists in the frozen data.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add a fixed-unknown field to the bundle schema or annotate these entries, and make V-17 distinguish fixed one-off from unit-variable unknowns.

findings.title: WATCH monitoring returns line rounds to 2.94 where 3% of net revenue gives 2.95
findings.evidence: docs/marea/economics/data/unit-economics.json: UE-WATCH-WATCH-MONITORING-SUBSCRIPTION-ANNUAL SVC-RETURNS amountEur 2.94; 3% x net 98.18 = 2.9454, round-half-up 2.95. Already disclosed in docs/marea/economics/MC-12-DELIVERY.md:143-144 and MC12-SENSITIVITY-AND-STRESS-ANALYSIS.md.
findings.description: The SVC-RETURNS derivation is truncated rather than round-half-up; the record remains internally consistent (knownVariableCostEur 13.05 equals the line sum) and no contribution error beyond 0.01 arises.
findings.requiredCorrection: State the truncation rule or use 2.95 with knownVariableCostEur 13.06 and the dependent contribution values updated.

findings.title: Bundle aggregates compose two documented FX bases
findings.evidence: docs/marea/economics/data/bundle-economics.json: BE-START knownVariableCostEur 293.55 = HUB 281.13 (MC-11 BOM basis 0.925925926 USD/EUR) + NAV 12.42 (recurring model derived with ECB 0.8916 USD/EUR). ASM-MC12-021 and MC12-PROVIDER-RESEARCH-AND-PRICE-REGISTER.md §4 state 'no subtotal mixes two conversion bases'; D-051 forbids rebasing inherited MC-11 lines.
findings.description: Every register is internally consistent and the inherited MC-11 lines are correctly not rebased, which is what D-051 requires. However, bundle-level knownVariableCostEur sums hardware (inherited basis) and subscription (ECB basis) components, so the statement 'no subtotal mixes two bases' is true for the cost registers but not for bundle aggregates.
findings.requiredCorrection: Scope the D-051 / provider-register wording to the cost registers, or annotate bundle aggregates with the two conversion bases. No arithmetic change is required.
